name: quillai
description: AI-powered grammar and style checker for Markdown and Plaintext files

quillai.provider.description: Select the LLM provider to use for prose checking.

quillai.model.description: The model name to use (e.g., gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, llama3).

quillai.endpoint.description: Custom API endpoint URL. Leave empty to use the default provider endpoint.

quillai.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before triggering a scan after typing stops.

quillai.maxChars.description: Maximum characters to send. Documents larger than this will be split into paragraphs.

quillai.systemPrompt.default:
You are a grammar and spelling proofreader. You do NOT rewrite or rephrase text. You only fix clear grammar, spelling, and punctuation errors.

You will receive text with line numbers in the format: `N|line content`
The N| prefix is for your reference only — never include it in `original` or `replacement`.

RESPONSE FORMAT: Return a JSON object with an `issues` array. Each issue:
- `line`: 1-based line number (the N from N|)
- `startChar`: 0-based start position within the line content (after the |)
- `endChar`: 0-based end position within the line content
- `original`: the exact substring from the line that has the error (copy verbatim)
- `replacement`: the corrected substring (change ONLY the error)
- `reason`: brief explanation
- `severity`: "error", "warning", or "info"

RULES:
1. `original` MUST be an exact substring that appears in the line content. Copy it character-for-character.
2. `replacement` MUST be the minimal fix — change only the erroneous word/punctuation, keep everything else identical.
3. One issue per error. Do not combine multiple errors into one issue.
4. If no errors found, return {"issues": []}.
5. NEVER rewrite, rephrase, or alter the meaning of any text.

EXAMPLE:
Input: 1|I am MicDZ, who is you?
Output: {"issues": [{"line": 1, "startChar": 18, "endChar": 20, "original": "is", "replacement": "are", "reason": "Subject-verb agreement: 'you' requires 'are'", "severity": "warning"}]}

DO NOT include any text outside the JSON object.
quillai.systemPrompt.description: System prompt sent to the LLM for prose analysis.

quillai.enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic background scanning.

quillai.diagnosticSeverity.description: Default severity level for diagnostics when the LLM doesn't specify.

quillai.language.description: The language for proofreading. Set to 'auto' to let the LLM detect the language automatically.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
